review_output: {"summary":"The original gate stays FAIL. It requires 20 synchronized Serializable snapshots, each with at most 2 attempts, to give 20/20 commits. PostgreSQL SSI does not promise that for indexed tables. Locks taken by index reads cover whole index pages, and an update that changes an indexed column must add new index entries (it can't be done in place, a 'HOT' update). Those two effects create false conflicts between writes to different orders. That fits plain 20/20 vs indexed 2/20 with no product triggers, though the mechanism hasn't been measured yet. So this is a throughput/liveness target, not a correctness invariant. It should sit next to the original gate, not replace it, and needs owner approval. The correct gates: no lost payments, exactly-once effects, durable recovery, and no regression against the pre-WP20 baseline. The regression question is still open. The order revision helper/cache looks correct within a read-only repeatable-read snapshot. WP20 remains incomplete.","findings":[{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"scripts/wp20-ssi-minimal-disposable.mjs","area":"Acceptance semantics","issue":"The universal simultaneous-snapshot 20/20 gate with 2 attempts asserts something PostgreSQL SSI does not promise for indexed tables.","evidence":"Plain: 20/20. Indexed: 2/20 with 37 errors 40001/P2034. Every transaction reads the same index leaf page with a page-level lock, and the indexed update must insert new index entries on that page.","impact":"The gate's result depends on physical layout (indexes, free space for in-place updates), not on payment correctness, so it can't be used to judge a fix.","recommended_fix":"Keep the original FAIL. Propose separate gates for owner approval: (a) 20 synchronized snapshots must end 20/20, exactly once, nothing lost, under a stated retry/backoff budget plus durable recovery; (b) inline commit rate must not regress against baseline.","required_test":"Capture n_tup_hot_upd and the SIREAD page locks in pg_locks for the plain and indexed cases to prove the mechanism.","confidence":0.8},{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"prisma/migrations/20261015140000_live_metric_order_source/migration.sql","area":"Regression vs baseline","issue":"A disabled trigger is not the baseline. The trigger also adds reads inside the Serializable payment transaction (the PaymentTransaction and Live SELECTs), which widens the lock footprint.","evidence":"The gate fails with the trigger disabled, but no run of the pre-WP20 commit is supplied.","impact":"We can't tell whether the failure is old behaviour or something WP20 made worse.","recommended_fix":"Treat the failure as old behaviour only after a measured baseline exists, and measure how much the trigger adds.","required_test":"Run the original gate 10 or more times each on the merge-base, HEAD with the trigger off, and HEAD with the trigger on. Compare the commit and failure counts and any indexed columns that changed.","confidence":0.75},{"severity":"MAJOR","file":"payment callback path (not supplied)","area":"Product implementation path","issue":"Correctness has to come from durable storage plus idempotency, not from first-try commits. Table-level admission runs every writer one at a time.","evidence":"The signed-callback fixture stored failed events, and sequential recovery processed all 20 exactly once. No deployed scheduler exists. SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE conflicts with itself, so it blocks every writer.","impact":"If the system relies on inline retries alone, payments can be lost. A global lock hurts throughput and risks deadlocks with other code paths.","recommended_fix":"Save the verified event in a short read-committed transaction with a unique (provider,eventId). Then process it as Serializable with jittered, deadline-bounded retries and an idempotent state transition. Leave it pending if retries run out. Deploy a worker that uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED. Optionally remove indexes on hot-updated columns. Consider read-committed with row locks only after analysing invariants. Global locks only with a throughput study.","required_test":"Fire a synchronized 20-event burst with worker crashes injected.
